entities.name: Spéranza Calo-Séailles

entities.summary: Spéranza Calo-Séailles or Elpís Kalogeropoúlou was a Greek painter, inventor and opera singer. Though better known as a singer and artist, she also invented a type of decorative concrete which went under the name Lap.
